## Rejected candidates
- Previous Menna.Hassan100 reef: weak underwater clarity.
- Previous Abu Dabbab dugong: long edge below 3,000 px.
- Nabq mangrove 19: overexposed water and weak scene detail.
- Red Sea 21: distracting foreground and soft focus.
- Mangrove RasMohammed: heavy shadows and distant trees.
- Shutterstock/Getty results: no permitted redistribution licence.

Florida, US Virgin Islands and Great Barrier Reef bleaching images are clearly labelled comparison images; they do not document bleaching in either atlas basin.

## Geographic matching

The point panel ranks georeferenced photographs by great-circle distance. GPS or Commons location-template coordinates are distinguished from approximate centres of named source areas. Approximate positions are labelled in the interface. Photos illustrate the nearby coast or habitat; they do not verify habitat presence at an SST cell.

The current catalogue contains 47 unique originals. New regional originals were inspected together in contact sheets before publication. The duplicate Al Thakira source was removed. Workshop, military, unrelated-country and weak night images were rejected.
